desc:
⚔️ Slash the World ⚔️
Swing your sword and slice entire cities in half! Every piece you cut really falls. 🏙️💥

💰 Earn cash for everything you destroy
🗡️ Unlock new swords, from a wooden blade to cosmic legends
🌍 Travel through 9 worlds, from the Forest to Heaven
🐾 Hatch pets, collect relics and unleash skills like the Black Hole
🏆 Destroy a whole world to win a trophy, then rebirth for even more power
👥 Play with friends and climb the global leaderboard

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new swords and worlds!
